answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a $40 bond in a vault and builds a behavior atlas over 20 epochs: task mix, timing rhythm, counterparties, cross-checked like a trellis of signals. A copied script cannot fake 20 epochs of work, so its bond stays locked. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 against a $3,000 pool, while an honest agent pays $40 once, stays consistent, and unlocks its full share.
